verdict.rationale: AngelList's equity management docs cover cap table operations: option exercises, 409A valuation requests, ASC 718 reports, health checks and board consents. Nothing in the pack shows Rule 701 disclosure threshold tracking, Form 3921 generation or 83(b) election handling. ASC 718 reporting and 409A requests are adjacent compliance features and do not transfer to this story. The axis clearly applies to a cap table product, so the lack of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As an ops user, US equity compliance — Rule 701 disclosure thresholds, Form 3921 filings, 83(b) elections — is tracked and generated from the cap table automatically
